source_execution.functions: same five byte-exact pinned public MemTest functions

oracles: independent integer ceil/branch relation for sends/receipts/waiting polls
actual source functions and endpoint register transitions
explicit phase expansion for each target P=1..2p and all phases, compared with canonical master projection
prefix minimum checked separately from recurrent minimum
controls: Keep ties and nonpositive candidate-policy queries as unknown/rejected; never replace them with another parameter case.
scope: Parameterized characterization and finite corroboration of this same specified receiver/client family, not independent programs, native cache, arbitrary workloads, complete WU enumeration for each new parameter, or hardware evidence.
